name: Vision agent with ASL mode
tagline: A kagent-based agent that captures webcam photos and transforms them into AI-augmented media, with an American Sign Language mode.
problem: Newcomers to agents rarely build something delightful or accessible.
solution: An agent with vision on kagent that takes webcam photos and remixes them with image and video generation models, plus an ASL mode.
demo_moment: The demo video — the organizer said it made her smile.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Fun and creative; the demo video produced an emotional reaction in the judge.
Accessibility (ASL mode) called out as a 'huge bonus'.

lessons: An accessibility mode is a cheap, high-signal bonus on top of a fun demo.
